system.description: Any task the character can begin and reasonably hope to finish, she can finish, even if circumstances change during the task's execution. Regardless of penalty, the character can continue working as she did when she started; she is not immune to the negative effects of fatigue, injury or environmental conditions, but may continue despite them. Even if she is killed, her ghost continues to work at the task, as does her body as long as it isn't destroyed.
